title: Classical adic strata for the raw rational constructible heart
statement:
Fix a prime power $q=p^a$, $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell
e p$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and an isomorphism $\iota:\Qlb\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf C$, as in [def-weil-punctual-weights]. Let $T$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme and $M\in\operatorname{Sh}_c(T,\Qlb)$ in the raw/common-stage heart of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex; def-weil-constructible-standard-tstructure]. There are a finite coefficient field $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in $\Qlb$, a representative $M_E$ in the raw $E$-heart, and a finite partition $T=\coprod_
u T_
u$ by reduced locally closed subschemes [def-constructible-stratification], such that each $M|_{T_
u}$ is the realization, by the lisse realization functor of [lem-tw-lisse-rational-realization], of a classical lisse $\Qlb$-sheaf of [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves]. More precisely, at the same $E$ each restriction has a lisse integral lattice $L_
u$ over $B_{E,T_
u}=\varprojlim_n(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n)_{T_
u}$ whose localization realizes $M_E|_{T_
u}$. The reductions $L_{
u,n}$ are finite locally free sheaves on $(T_
u)_{\mathrm{et}}$ with $L_{
u,n+1}\otimes_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1}}\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n\cong L_{
u,n}$.

The comparison from the sf raw heart to the PBC raw heart is the identity-induced $J$ of [lem-fd-rational-coefficient-category-comparison]; it identifies their cohomological halves and geometric fibres. At a finite stage its continuous module realization, the equivalence of [lem-per-continuous-rational-derived-realization], has coefficient ring $B_{E,T}[1/\varpi_E]$. The continuous and pulled-back condensed coefficient rings, integrally as well as rationally, are identified with these displayed rings by their finite-quotient projections. The resulting classical lisse realizations are fully faithful on maps, identify adic point fibres and iterated geometric-Frobenius point transports, and commute with further locally closed restriction and finite coefficient extension. In particular, if $T=Y_0	imes_{k_0}k$ for a separated finite-type $Y_0$, and $M$ has a Weil structure, then on any further locally closed piece defined over $k_m=\mathbf F_{q^m}$ inside one $T_
u$, its iterated Weil map comes from a classical lisse Weil isomorphism. No Frobenius stability of the initial partition or of the integral lattices is required.

When $T=(Y_0	imes_{k_0}k)_{\mathrm{red}}$ for a separated finite-type $Y_0$, there is one finite $k_m/k_0$ and a finite reduced closed chain $Z_0=(Y_0	imes_{k_0}k_m)_{\mathrm{red}}\supset\cdots\supset Z_t=\varnothing$ whose open differences are finite disjoint unions of nonempty smooth geometrically connected affine $k_m$-schemes of constant nonnegative dimension, with all inclusions defined over $k_m$. Their geometric base changes refine the displayed classical-lisse partition, and the restrictions of $M$ remain classical lisse with the same normalized pullback and coefficient comparisons. A zero-dimensional piece is $\operatorname{Spec}k_m$.
